timeline.name: p2p
timeline.provenance: explicit-topology latency + phase link-load/bandwidth analytical scenario
assumptions: One logical collective counted once across all participants.
Ring rank order follows participants; pairwise all-to-all uses cyclic destination offsets.
Routes use explicit paths or deterministic minimum-hop routing; no adaptive routing.
Per-phase pipelined links, summed hop latencies and shared-resource serialization.
Scheduler reserves all network resources for the full operation; conservative inter-operation contention.
Bidirectional links share capacity; full duplex requires separate directed resources.
No NCCL protocol, packet overhead, GPU reduction kernel or memory-bandwidth interference model.

summary.logical_memory_model: program-order reference-owned GPU tensor storage; excludes CPU/meta storage, allocator reserve, kernel workspaces and deferred GPU usage
summary.scheduling_model: one serialized compute lane and one communication lane per rank
summary.overlap_model: ideal compute/communication overlap; explicit shared network resources serialize whole communication operations
summary.memory_model: physical live storage with alias references and deferred reclamation; no caching/reserved model; conservative allocation-before-free ties
limitations: CPU/meta-device arithmetic/control durations are unmodeled and contribute no device time.
Collective participant rendezvous must be supplied as explicit dependencies.
Host launch overhead is zero unless host_time_us encodes it.
Analytical durations are lower bounds, not predicted measured runtimes.
No same-stream allocator reuse before physical reclamation.
